decisions.reason: The supplement range builds on the firm's established OTC pharmacy business, has its own web page, and fits the firm's stated push into consumer health, so results appear satisfactory and the large, expanding firm has slack to carry it.
The skin and hair supplement was actively promoted as a new pharmacy offer and uses existing channels at low cost, so there is no shortfall signal to trigger search for alternatives.
The joint health supplement extends the Trivital brand into an established category, and the firm's slack lets it carry the product while results build.
The mushroom-based immune supplement is a more niche product that is only mentioned on the website, which adds some uncertainty, but its low carrying cost and the firm's slack favour keeping it.

The 2018 valsartan contamination recall is a clear shortfall against aspirations, and the product sits far from the firm's core in a low-margin generics segment, so problemistic search is likely to redirect these resources.
